newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 RISES 5.48 PCT, M2 UP 0.87 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 RISES 5.48 PCT, M2 UP 0.87 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 504.5 billion levs on April 4 from 478.3 billion levs a week earlier and M2 rose to 3,012.7 billion levs from 2,986.8 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.
Total broad money increased 0.4 percent to 3,213.2 billion levs in the week to April 4.
Lev-denominated broad money rose 5.35 percent to 1,067.8 billion levs while dollar-denominated broad money edged down 1.9 percent to 2,145.4 billion levs.

Hard currency-denominated deposits of companies fell to $740 million on April 4 from $768.8 million on March 28, while individuals' foreign currency deposits rose $4.8 million to $484.3 million, figures showed.
Lev-denominated deposits of individuals edged up to 83 billion levs on April 4 from 81.3 billion levs the week before.
The lev eased to 1,599.9 per dollar on April 4 in the central bank fixing used in the calculations from 1,590.8 on March 28. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
